tasks.title: Freeze 2–4 stage TOEC module calibration and compactness thresholds
tasks.success_test: A 2–4 stage instrumented module contract defines exact source/stage heat, temperature, pressure and loaded-flow measurements plus uncertainty; the R075 model is inverted into measured thresholds for heat recovery, membrane packing, thermal-network W/L and header loss that separate a credible <=2 L path from a dead branch.

tasks.title: Build multi-stage TOEC heat-recovery and packaging scaling model
tasks.success_test: A reproducible model compares 60/20°C and 80/40°C for N=1/4/8/16/38 with explicit per-stage thermal profile, source heat, heat recovery, conductive/parasitic heat, membrane area, hydraulic power, header/structural volume and PTO; it reports W/L and fraction of Carnot and applies the R074 10 W/2 L decision gate without treating modelled literature numbers as measured module data.

tasks.title: Implement phase-aware coupon digital experiment and uncertainty gate
tasks.success_test: Repo can deterministically compute the frozen-point diffusion/phase screen, propagate measurement uncertainty to Re{G*}/V and wet loss, classify pass/inconclusive/fail against R073 gates, and emit a machine-readable result with tests.

tasks.title: Freeze buildable coupon instrumentation packet without inventing data
tasks.success_test: Exact sensor/geometry/calibration/BOM-level measurement contract is frozen, risks are explicit, and the branch is marked hardware-blocked if no further desk uncertainty can be removed.

tasks.title: Reopen thermo-osmotic hydraulic branch with fair power-density baseline
tasks.success_test: Identify the strongest modern thermo-osmotic architecture, quantify source-to-electric path and area/volume power density against a fair direct-thermal baseline, and either define one decisive model/experiment or downgrade it.

tasks.title: Portfolio synthesis and next-task seeding
tasks.success_test: Re-rank surviving branches from durable evidence, close stale loops, and seed only 1-5 concrete uncertainty-reducing tasks; do not create work merely to keep the scheduler busy.
tasks.last_release_note: Published R080 SYNTHESIS and opened exactly one fresh-evidence branch EVOSM-01 for one system-level audit.

tasks.title: Audit evaporation-maintained osmotic electricity from measured large-area performance
tasks.success_test: A reproducible 10 W whole-system envelope anchored to the measured 1000 cm² / 0.66 W/m² result closes membrane area/packing, evaporation source footprint and mass flux, salinity inventory, source exergy and parasitics; it compares direct osmotic electricity to R019 hydraulic PRO under the same source and either preserves only a credible application regime or downgrades it.
tasks.last_release_note: Published R081. Compact 10 W / 2 L EVOSM downgraded to LOW PRIORITY from measured large-area density plus ~100 µm membrane geometry. Preserve only distributed-area data watch; no follow-on desk task seeded without new matched evidence.
